title: Rosa leaves the farm at noon
about: Farm, day 4, 11:58, standing a few tiles below Rosa at her morning spot (16,12). At 12:00 her schedule takes her to town: she walks to the farm's gate south and goes through it, never vanishing on screen (owner: "sometimes the NPCs appear from nowhere or just disappear"). The e2e block npcPops also runs the town at 07:58 (villagers walking in through doors) on npc-arrive-town.
